result.requirement: The system shall maintain synchronized, real-time inventory levels across all Store/Fulfillment Centers to prevent overselling of perishable goods and ensure accurate stock visibility.
result.business_need: The business requires immediate stock accuracy to prevent selling items that are out of stock or expired, thereby protecting revenue and maintaining customer trust.
functional_behaviour: The system shall receive and validate Real-Time Inventory Snapshots from Store Partners to update the central Product Catalog.
The system shall lock available stock quantities for an Order Request immediately upon allocation to prevent concurrent overselling.
The system shall monitor the integrity of the data link between the Store Partner and the platform to detect synchronization discrepancies.
The system shall prioritize the sale of perishable inventory based on freshness status and expiration dates.
The system shall release locked stock quantities if an Order Request is cancelled or times out within the defined window.
related_information_requirements: The current, validated quantity of each sellable item (SKU) at a specific store location, including status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability.
Data indicating the status of the data link between the store's Point of Sale and the platform, including latency, last sync time, and detected discrepancies.
Information regarding the expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods.
business_rules: Stock quantities must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the fulfillment task is completed or the order is cancelled.
Perishable items must be prioritized for allocation to orders based on their proximity to the expiration date.
The system must flag a synchronization discrepancy if the data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
Locked stock must be automatically released if the Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner updates the quantity of a perishable SKU in their Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to allocate an Order Request for that SKU
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall reflect the updated quantity immediately and allow allocation only if stock is sufficient

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request has successfully locked stock for a perishable item
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer cancels the Order Request before the fulfillment task begins
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall release the locked stock quantity back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for other orders

result.requirement: The system shall automatically assign incoming orders to the nearest Store Partner that has sufficient Real-Time Inventory Snapshot and available capacity.
result.business_need: The business requires instant, optimal allocation of orders to physical nodes to minimize delivery time and prevent inventory overselling.
functional_behaviour: The system shall calculate the distance between the customer location and all eligible Store Partners.
The system shall validate that the selected Store Partner has sufficient stock for every item in the Order Request.
The system shall create a Fulfillment Task linked to the assigned Store Partner and Delivery Assignment.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect the reserved quantities immediately.
The system shall notify the Store Partner of the new Fulfillment Task via the assigned Delivery Slot.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
The current, validated quantity of each sellable item (SKU) at a specific store location, including status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability.
The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.
business_rules: An order must only be assigned to a store if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.
If no store has sufficient inventory for the complete order, the system must not assign the order and must flag it for manual review.
The system must prioritize the nearest store based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time.
Inventory quantities reserved by an automatic assignment must be immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to prevent overselling.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer places an Order Request with items available at multiple Store Partners
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock and creates a Fulfillment Task

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer places an Order Request where no Store Partner has sufficient stock for all items
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task

result.requirement: The system shall enable Delivery Partners to view, accept, and manage their assigned delivery slots while ensuring dynamic agent assignment and capacity verification.
result.business_need: The business needs to optimize last-mile logistics by ensuring the right agent receives orders based on real-time capacity and workload status.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow Delivery Partners to view available delivery slots within their defined service area.
The system shall enable the Order Allocation Engine to dynamically assign delivery tasks to agents based on current workload and proximity.
The system shall verify agent capacity before confirming a delivery slot assignment to prevent overloading.
The system shall update the agent's workload status in real-time as they accept or reject delivery tasks.
The system shall display the estimated arrival time and route details for each assigned delivery slot.
related_information_requirements: The active linkage between a ready order and a specific delivery agent, including the assigned route, estimated arrival time, and the agent's current workload status.
Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.
The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance between the store location and potential customer addresses, accounting for traffic patterns and route constraints.
business_rules: A delivery slot cannot be assigned to an agent if their current workload exceeds the maximum capacity defined for their service zone.
An agent must explicitly accept a delivery assignment before the system confirms the slot as active.
Dynamic reassignment of a delivery task is only permitted if the original agent rejects the task or exceeds capacity limits.
The system must recalculate estimated arrival times if traffic patterns change significantly after the initial assignment.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner is logged in and viewing their dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine assigns a new delivery task within their service zone
acceptance_criteria.then: The system displays the delivery slot details including route, estimated arrival time, and item list for the partner to accept or reject

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner has reached their maximum workload capacity
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new delivery task to that partner
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the assignment and routes the task to another available agent within the same service zone

result.requirement: The system shall capture and verify digital proof of delivery via direct input or external API retrieval before releasing funds.
result.business_need: The business needs irrefutable evidence of physical handover to close the logistics loop and trigger financial settlement securely.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Delivery Partner to capture a digital signature, timestamped photo, or automated confirmation code upon handover.
The system shall retrieve delivery proof automatically from an external courier API when the Delivery Partner does not generate local evidence.
The system shall validate the authenticity and completeness of the received delivery proof before updating the order status.
The system shall release funds to the Store Partner only after the delivery proof is successfully verified and stored.
The system shall generate a Dispute Ticket if the provided proof fails validation or is missing required elements.
related_information_requirements: Digital signature or timestamped photo confirming physical handover
Automated confirmation code from external courier systems
Verification status of the delivery evidence
Timestamp and location data associated with the proof
business_rules: Funds shall not be released until a valid delivery proof is recorded in the system.
Proof retrieved via external API shall be treated with the same verification standards as locally captured proof.
A Dispute Ticket shall be created if the delivery proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature.
The system shall reject delivery proof if the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner completes a physical handover and captures a digital signature
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the submission
acceptance_criteria.then: The system validates the proof and releases funds to the Store Partner

acceptance_criteria.given: The external courier API returns an invalid or missing delivery confirmation
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to retrieve proof for a completed delivery
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket and blocks fund release

result.requirement: The system shall automatically calculate and distribute transaction revenue to the Platform Operator, Store Partner, and Payment Provider immediately upon delivery confirmation.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure accurate, transparent, and timely financial settlement for all parties involved in a transaction to maintain trust and operational efficiency.
functional_behaviour: The system shall validate the Delivery Proof associated with the Order Request before initiating any financial distribution.
The system shall retrieve the commission rates and payout terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
The system shall calculate the net settlement amount for each party based on the Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall generate a Financial Transaction Record detailing the split of revenue between the Platform Operator, Store Partner, and Payment Provider.
The system shall update the status of the Order Request to 'Settled' once the distribution logic is executed.
The system shall flag the transaction for manual review if the calculated amounts deviate from expected thresholds based on historical data.
related_information_requirements: Complete record of monetary exchange including item costs, fees, taxes, and commissions
Verifiable evidence of physical goods handover to the customer
Contractual details regarding commission rates and payout schedules
Verified details of the ordering individual and delivery address
Qualitative ratings regarding product quality and delivery speed
business_rules: Financial distribution shall only occur after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
Transactions involving high-risk indicators must be paused for manual verification before settlement.
Settlement calculations must strictly adhere to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
A Financial Transaction Record must be generated for every completed delivery regardless of outcome.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the settlement event
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with correct split amounts for all parties

acceptance_criteria.given: The Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
acceptance_criteria.then: The system prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review

result.requirement: The system shall generate real-time alerts for inventory items approaching their shelf-life limits to prioritize fulfillment or trigger removal.
result.business_need: The business needs to minimize waste and maintain product quality by proactively managing perishable stock before it becomes unsellable.
functional_behaviour: The system shall continuously monitor the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for items where the remaining shelf life falls below a defined threshold.
The system shall automatically flag these items within the Product Catalog to indicate they are nearing expiry.
The system shall notify the Store Partner and the Order Allocation Engine to prioritize the sale or removal of flagged items.
The system shall update the status of affected items to prevent new Order Requests from being created for them.
The system shall log all expiry alerts and subsequent actions in a Feedback Record for performance analysis.
related_information_requirements: Expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods
Current stock levels and location of items
Thresholds for defining 'nearing expiry' status
Action history for flagged inventory items
business_rules: An item is considered 'nearing expiry' if its remaining shelf life is less than the configured safety margin.
New Order Requests must be rejected if the primary fulfillment source contains items flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
The system must update the Product Catalog status immediately upon detecting an expiry alert.
All expiry alerts must be logged with a timestamp and the specific item identifier.

acceptance_criteria.given: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows an item with 2 days remaining until its sell-by date, and the configured threshold is 3 days.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system performs its scheduled inventory quality check.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the item in the Product Catalog and sends an alert to the Store Partner.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to place an Order Request containing an item flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the Order Request and notifies the customer that the item is unavailable due to quality constraints.

result.requirement: The system shall automatically generate and track a Dispute Ticket when a Delivery Proof indicates a missing item, damage, or failed delivery.
result.business_need: The business needs an automated mechanism to capture exceptions early, ensuring fair resolution and accurate financial adjustments without manual intervention.
functional_behaviour: The system shall create a Dispute Ticket linked to the specific Order Request upon detection of a delivery exception.
The system shall record the nature of the issue, such as missing items, damages, or failed deliveries, within the ticket.
The system shall update the Dispute Ticket status to reflect current resolution progress throughout the lifecycle.
The system shall associate the relevant Delivery Proof and Financial Transaction Record with the ticket for verification.
The system shall notify the Customer and Delivery Partner of the dispute creation and required actions.
related_information_requirements: Nature of the deviation from standard process
Current resolution status of the exception
Verifiable evidence of physical goods handover failure
Specific list of items affected by the dispute
business_rules: A Dispute Ticket must be created immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception.
The Dispute Ticket status must transition from 'Open' to 'Resolved' only after a final decision is recorded.
A Dispute Ticket must remain linked to the original Order Request for the duration of the resolution process.
Financial adjustments cannot be finalized until the Dispute Ticket is marked as Resolved.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner submits a Delivery Proof showing a package was damaged during transit
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the delivery proof
acceptance_criteria.then: A Dispute Ticket is automatically generated with status 'Open' and linked to the Order Request

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer reports a missing item and the system attempts to generate a Dispute Ticket
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects the delivery proof is missing or incomplete
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket with status 'Pending Investigation' and notifies the Customer

result.requirement: The system shall retrieve, validate, and store external regulatory licenses and food safety certifications for Store Partners to ensure legal operation.
result.business_need: The business needs to mitigate legal risks and maintain trust by ensuring all Store Partners operate within required regulatory boundaries.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically ingest license data from external regulatory sources or uploaded documents by Store Partners.
The system shall validate the authenticity of received licenses against known regulatory authority databases.
The system shall track the current compliance status of each Store Partner and flag any expired or invalid documents.
The system shall prevent order processing for Store Partners whose critical regulatory licenses are expired or invalid.
The system shall generate a compliance report detailing the status of all active regulatory documents for Store Partners.
related_information_requirements: Current records of licenses, permits, and regulatory adherence regarding food safety and labor laws.
Expiration dates and validity status of regulatory documents.
Geographic zones where the platform is authorized to operate based on regulatory permissions.
business_rules: A Store Partner must have a valid and non-expired food safety certificate to accept new orders.
The system must block order allocation to a Store Partner if their primary operating license is flagged as invalid.
Regulatory compliance status must be updated within 24 hours of receiving new data from external sources.
A Store Partner must be notified immediately if their license expiration date is within 30 days.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner uploads a valid food safety certificate with a future expiration date.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system ingests and validates the document against the Regulatory Authority database.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the Store Partner's compliance status to 'Active' and allows order allocation.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner's food safety certificate has expired in the external database.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system performs a scheduled validation check on the Store Partner's records.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the compliance status to 'Non-Compliant' and blocks all new order requests for that Store Partner.

result.requirement: The system shall manage the full lifecycle of the Customer Profile, enabling the creation, modification, and archival of identity and preference records throughout the customer's engagement.
result.business_need: The business needs a centralized, accurate record of customer identity and preferences to ensure secure order routing, accurate financial settlement, and personalized service delivery.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow authorized actors to create a new Customer Profile with unique identifiers and verified contact details.
The system shall enable authorized actors to update existing Customer Profile information, including address changes and preference updates.
The system shall archive Customer Profile data upon account closure or significant status changes while retaining historical records.
The system shall enforce data validation rules to ensure all stored identity and contact information meets regulatory and operational standards.
The system shall link the Customer Profile to associated Order Requests and Financial Transaction Records for a complete audit trail.
related_information_requirements: Unique customer identifiers and verified delivery addresses
Primary contact methods including phone and email
Customer preference history and special handling notes
Fraud risk indicators and transaction patterns
Account status and archival timestamps
business_rules: A Customer Profile must contain a unique identifier before any Order Request can be associated with it.
Contact details within a Customer Profile must be verified before the profile status is set to active.
Archived Customer Profiles must retain all historical data and cannot be modified after the archival action is confirmed.
Any modification to a Customer Profile must be timestamped and attributed to the actor performing the change.

acceptance_criteria.given: An actor initiates the creation of a new customer account
acceptance_criteria.when: The actor enters valid unique identifiers and contact details
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates a new Customer Profile with an active status and links it to the actor's session

acceptance_criteria.given: An actor attempts to modify a Customer Profile with invalid data
acceptance_criteria.when: The data fails validation rules for required fields or format
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the update and displays a specific error message indicating the validation failure

result.requirement: The system shall manage the full lifecycle of Store Partner Agreements, enabling the creation, amendment, and historical tracking of commercial terms while controlling access to these documents.
result.business_need: The business needs to maintain legally binding, auditable records of commercial terms to ensure operational compliance and accurate financial settlements with store partners.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Platform Operator to create new agreements or amend existing ones with updated commercial terms.
The system shall automatically generate a new version of the agreement upon any amendment and retain the previous version in the history.
The system shall enforce access provisioning so that only authorized actors can view or edit specific agreement versions.
The system shall prevent the execution of orders against a Store Partner Agreement that is marked as inactive or superseded.
The system shall provide a version history view allowing the Platform Operator to compare changes between agreement versions.
The system shall notify the Store Partner of any changes to their active agreement terms.
related_information_requirements: Commission rates and payout schedules
Liability clauses and performance guarantees
Agreement status and version history
Authorized user access lists
business_rules: An amendment to an active agreement must immediately create a new version number while marking the previous version as historical.
A Store Partner Agreement must be marked as 'Active' before any associated Order Requests can be allocated to that partner.
Access to edit an agreement version is restricted to the Platform Operator and the Store Partner associated with that agreement.
The system must prevent the deletion of any agreement version once it has been created.

acceptance_criteria.given: The Platform Operator initiates an amendment to an active Store Partner Agreement
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the amendment request
acceptance_criteria.then: A new version of the agreement is created with updated terms, and the previous version is archived as historical data.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner attempts to allocate an Order Request to a partner with an inactive agreement
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine validates the partner status
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the allocation and prevents the creation of the Delivery Assignment.

result.requirement: The system shall enable the Merchandiser to create, update, and archive product catalog entries while enforcing data validation and version control.
result.business_need: The business needs a structured way to manage product lifecycle data to ensure accurate inventory representation and prevent overselling.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Merchandiser to add new items to the Product Catalog with required attributes.
The system shall allow the Merchandiser to modify existing item details and automatically archive the previous version.
The system shall validate input data against defined business rules before saving any catalog changes.
The system shall maintain a history of all product changes for audit and rollback purposes.
The system shall prevent the modification of archived product versions to ensure data integrity.
related_information_requirements: Product descriptions and images
Standardized pricing data
Category classifications
Version history of catalog entries
Validation status of product data
business_rules: A product entry cannot be updated if it is in an archived state.
All product updates must include a timestamp and the identifier of the user making the change.
Required fields such as product name and price must be populated before a new entry is created.
Previous versions of a product must be retained and marked as archived when a new version is published.

acceptance_criteria.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
acceptance_criteria.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

acceptance_criteria.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry with a missing required field
acceptance_criteria.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the missing field

result.requirement: The system shall enable the Platform Operator to create, modify, and version geospatial service area definitions and travel time matrices to ensure accurate delivery feasibility and pricing.
result.business_need: The business needs this to dynamically restrict order acceptance to feasible areas and calculate accurate delivery fees based on real-time traffic and route constraints.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Platform Operator to define service areas using precise geographic coordinates, radii, or polygon boundaries.
The system shall calculate and store travel duration and distance estimates between store locations and potential customer addresses.
The system shall maintain a version history of all changes made to service area definitions and travel time matrices.
The system shall automatically invalidate existing Delivery Zone Maps when a new version is published.
The system shall expose the active service area definitions to the Order Allocation Engine for real-time order validation.
related_information_requirements: Precise geographic coordinates, radii, or polygon boundaries defining service zones
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance accounting for traffic patterns
Version history of service area changes including timestamps and change descriptions
Active linkage between service zones and specific store locations
business_rules: A new version of a Service Area Definition must supersede the previous active version immediately upon publication.
Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition must be rejected by the Order Allocation Engine.
Travel time matrices must be recalculated whenever a Service Area Definition is modified to reflect updated route constraints.
All modifications to Service Area Definitions must be logged with a timestamp and the identity of the Platform Operator.

acceptance_criteria.given: The Platform Operator has access to the zone management module
acceptance_criteria.when: The operator creates a new polygon boundary for a delivery zone and publishes it
acceptance_criteria.then: The system stores the new definition as the active version and invalidates the previous zone map

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is submitted for an address outside the defined service area
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to validate the order against the active Service Area Definition
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the order and logs the rejection reason as 'outside service zone'

result.requirement: The system shall enable the secure creation, retention, and long-term archival of detailed financial ledgers and settlement records for all monetary exchanges.
result.business_need: The business needs immutable financial records to ensure accurate revenue sharing, support regulatory audits, and provide verifiable evidence for dispute resolution.
functional_behaviour: The system shall capture the complete record of monetary exchange including item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
The system shall store indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions such as unusual order patterns or payment anomalies.
The system shall link the financial transaction record to verifiable evidence that physical goods have reached the customer.
The system shall archive the legally binding contractual details between the platform and store partners including commission rates and payout schedules.
The system shall maintain a structured record of any deviation from the standard process including missing items or failed deliveries with current resolution status.
related_information_requirements: Complete record of monetary exchange detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
Indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions.
Verifiable evidence that physical goods have reached the customer.
Legally binding contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules.
Structured record of deviations from the standard process including nature of issue and resolution status.
business_rules: A financial transaction record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts to be considered complete.
The system must link a financial transaction record to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status.
Any deviation from the standard process must be recorded with the nature of the issue and the current resolution status.
Contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules must be archived alongside the financial transaction record.

acceptance_criteria.given: A payment is processed between a customer and a store partner
acceptance_criteria.when: The system generates a financial transaction record
acceptance_criteria.then: The record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: A delivery proof is missing for a completed order
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to archive the financial transaction record
acceptance_criteria.then: The system must flag the record as incomplete and prevent final settlement until delivery proof is provided.

result.requirement: The system shall manage the full lifecycle of Service Area Definitions, enabling the creation, activation, deactivation, and historical tracking of geographically delimited delivery zones.
result.business_need: The business requires precise control over operational boundaries to ensure orders are only accepted and fulfilled within feasible geographic limits.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow authorized users to create new Service Area Definitions by specifying geographic boundaries or radii.
The system shall enable the activation and deactivation of Service Area Definitions to control service availability in real time.
The system shall maintain a complete historical audit trail of all changes made to Service Area Definitions including timestamps and user details.
The system shall validate that new Service Area Definitions do not conflict with existing operational constraints.
The system shall expose the current status and boundary details of Service Area Definitions to dependent modules for order validation.
related_information_requirements: Precise geographic coordinates, radii, or polygon boundaries defining specific zones.
Timestamps and user identifiers for all lifecycle state changes.
Current operational status of each defined service area.
business_rules: A Service Area Definition must be in an active state before it can be used to validate new Order Requests.
Any modification to an active Service Area Definition must be logged with the reason for change and the identity of the operator.
Deactivation of a Service Area Definition must immediately prevent the acceptance of new orders originating from that zone.
A Service Area Definition cannot be created if its geographic boundaries overlap with a restricted zone defined by the Regulatory Authority.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Platform Operator initiates the creation of a new delivery zone with valid geographic coordinates
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the request and the zone is successfully created
acceptance_criteria.then: The new Service Area Definition is saved with an 'Inactive' status until explicitly activated by an authorized user

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner attempts to place an order from a location within a Service Area Definition that has been deactivated
acceptance_criteria.when: The system validates the customer's address against the current Service Area Definitions
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the Order Request and displays a message indicating that delivery is not available in that zone

result.requirement: The system shall maintain an immutable chronological history of all status transitions for every Delivery Assignment from creation to final closure.
result.business_need: The business needs this to provide full auditability of the delivery lifecycle, enabling root cause analysis for delays and verifying compliance with service level agreements.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically generate a new status entry whenever a Delivery Assignment state changes.
The system shall record the exact timestamp and the actor responsible for initiating each status transition.
The system shall preserve the previous status value alongside the new status to show the direction of the change.
The system shall allow authorized users to query the complete history of a specific Delivery Assignment by its unique identifier.
The system shall prevent the deletion or alteration of historical status records once they are committed to the database.
The system shall display the sequence of statuses in chronological order to reconstruct the assignment's journey.
related_information_requirements: The specific status label (e.g., Assigned, In-Transit, Delivered) at any point in time.
The precise moment in time when a status change occurred.
The identity of the user or system process that triggered the status change.
The prior status held by the assignment immediately before the current change.
business_rules: A status transition is only valid if the new status logically follows the previous status in the defined lifecycle.
The system must record a status entry for every state change, regardless of whether the change was manual or automated.
Historical status records must remain read-only and cannot be modified after creation.
The history log must include the timestamp in the system's standard time zone.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is created and subsequently moves from 'Pending' to 'Assigned' and then to 'In-Transit'
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes these state changes
acceptance_criteria.then: The history log must contain three entries showing the sequence: Pending -> Assigned -> In-Transit with correct timestamps.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authorized user attempts to delete a historical status entry for a completed Delivery Assignment
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the deletion request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system must reject the request and preserve the original status record in the history log.

result.requirement: The system shall enforce role-based access control by granting or denying system actions based on the specific permissions assigned to each actor.
result.business_need: The business needs to restrict system access to ensure data security, operational integrity, and compliance with internal governance policies.
functional_behaviour: The system shall validate the current user's role against the required permission for every requested action.
The system shall deny access and log the attempt if the actor lacks the necessary permission.
The system shall allow access only if the actor possesses the specific permission required for the action.
The system shall update the actor's permission set upon successful role assignment or revocation.
The system shall prevent actors from accessing business objects outside their authorized scope.
related_information_requirements: Actor role and assigned permissions
Action type requested by the actor
Access attempt timestamp and outcome
business_rules: An actor may only perform an action if their assigned role includes the specific permission for that action.
Access attempts by actors without the required permission must be denied and recorded in an audit log.
Permission changes must take effect immediately for all subsequent access requests.
Actors cannot bypass role-based restrictions through direct data manipulation.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner attempts to view the Financial Transaction Record
acceptance_criteria.when: The system checks the Delivery Partner's permissions
acceptance_criteria.then: The system denies access and logs the failed attempt

acceptance_criteria.given: A Platform Operator attempts to modify the Product Catalog
acceptance_criteria.when: The system verifies the Platform Operator's permissions
acceptance_criteria.then: The system grants access to perform the modification

result.requirement: The system shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all Delivery Partners accessing the delivery agent mobile application to verify identity before granting access to operational tools.
result.business_need: The business requires secure verification to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive customer data and delivery instructions by malicious actors impersonating gig-workers.
functional_behaviour: The system shall require a primary credential, such as a unique agent ID or biometric scan, before allowing any login attempt.
The system shall issue a one-time verification code via a secondary channel, such as SMS or email, upon successful entry of the primary credential.
The system shall deny access and lock the session if the primary and secondary credentials do not match within the defined time window.
The system shall log every authentication attempt, including success, failure, and the specific method used, for security auditing purposes.
The system shall automatically invalidate the session and require re-authentication if the agent's device is detected in an unauthorized geographic zone.
related_information_requirements: Unique agent identifier
Biometric data hash
Secondary channel verification code
Authentication timestamp
Device location coordinates
business_rules: Access is granted only when both the primary credential and the secondary verification code are valid and match.
A failed authentication attempt triggers an immediate lockout if the total number of consecutive failures exceeds the system threshold.
The secondary verification code expires after a short duration to prevent reuse.
Authentication logs must be immutable and retained for the duration of the regulatory compliance period.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner attempts to log in with valid credentials
acceptance_criteria.when: The system prompts for a secondary verification code
acceptance_criteria.then: Access is granted immediately upon entering the correct code within the time limit

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner attempts to log in with an incorrect primary credential
acceptance_criteria.when: The system requests a secondary verification code
acceptance_criteria.then: Access is denied and the session is terminated without issuing a code

result.requirement: The system shall enable Store Partner personnel to validate item quality against the order request before marking the fulfillment task as complete.
result.business_need: The business needs this to prevent shipping defective or incorrect items, thereby reducing returns and maintaining customer trust.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow Store Partner personnel to view the specific list of items, quantities, and special handling notes from the Order Request.
The system shall allow Store Partner personnel to inspect the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to confirm physical stock matches the digital record.
The system shall allow Store Partner personnel to record a quality verification status for each item in the Fulfillment Task.
The system shall prevent the Fulfillment Task from being marked as ready for dispatch if quality verification is not recorded.
The system shall allow Store Partner personnel to attach a Delivery Proof image confirming the item condition before finalizing the task.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
The current, validated quantity of each sellable item (SKU) at a specific store location, including status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability.
The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.
business_rules: A Fulfillment Task cannot transition to a 'Ready for Dispatch' status unless a quality verification record exists for every item.
If a quality check fails for any item, the system must flag the Fulfillment Task as 'Requires Correction' and block dispatch.
The system must display the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot alongside the Order Request to facilitate accurate physical verification.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner is preparing an order with multiple items
acceptance_criteria.when: The Store Partner completes the quality check for all items and confirms the order is correct
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the Fulfillment Task status to 'Ready for Dispatch' and allows the task to be transferred to a Delivery Partner

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner discovers a damaged item during the quality check
acceptance_criteria.when: The Store Partner attempts to mark the Fulfillment Task as complete without resolving the issue
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the completion action and displays an error message indicating that quality verification is incomplete

result.requirement: The system shall validate customer identity and contact details during the onboarding process to ensure compliance and secure account creation.
result.business_need: The business needs to verify customer identity to prevent fraud, ensure accurate delivery routing, and maintain regulatory compliance before allowing order placement.
functional_behaviour: The system shall collect unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods from the Customer during onboarding.
The system shall verify the authenticity of the provided identity documents against a trusted data source.
The system shall validate that the contact details match the provided identity information.
The system shall block account activation if identity verification fails or contact details are inconsistent.
The system shall generate a Verified Customer Profile upon successful validation.
The system shall log all verification attempts and outcomes for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: Unique identifiers for the ordering individual
Delivery addresses and primary contact methods
Verifiable evidence of identity documents
Indicators of fraudulent transaction likelihood
business_rules: A Customer Profile cannot be activated until identity verification is successful.
Contact details must match the name and address on the verified identity document.
Any failed verification attempt must generate a Dispute Ticket for manual review.
The system must flag accounts with inconsistent contact details for further investigation.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer submits valid identity documents and matching contact details
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the onboarding request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system activates the Customer Profile and allows order placement

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer submits mismatched contact details or invalid identity documents
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the onboarding request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the request and creates a Dispute Ticket for review

result.requirement: The system shall generate an immutable audit log for every action performed by authorized actors to satisfy external regulatory compliance requirements.
result.business_need: The business needs this to provide verifiable proof of operational adherence to labor, data privacy, and safety laws during regulatory inspections.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically capture the actor identity, timestamp, action type, and relevant context for every system interaction.
The system shall append a cryptographic hash to each log entry to ensure the record cannot be altered or deleted.
The system shall store the complete audit trail in a secure, read-only repository accessible only to the Regulatory Authority.
The system shall exclude internal system-generated events from the compliance log to focus on human-initiated actions.
The system shall retain the audit records for a duration defined by the applicable local jurisdiction's data retention laws.
related_information_requirements: Actor identity and role
Precise timestamp of the action
Type of action performed
Contextual data related to the action
Cryptographic hash of the record
business_rules: Every log entry must be immutable and tamper-evident.
Audit logs must be retained for a period not shorter than the minimum legal requirement for the operating zone.
Only actions initiated by human actors or their direct digital representations shall be logged for compliance.
The audit log must be accessible to the Regulatory Authority upon request without delay.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner updates the status of a Delivery Assignment to 'Delivered',
acceptance_criteria.when: the system records this event in the audit log,
acceptance_criteria.then: the log entry contains the partner's ID, the exact timestamp, and the action type, and the record is cryptographically sealed.

acceptance_criteria.given: An attempt is made to modify a stored audit log entry after it has been created,
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the modification request,
acceptance_criteria.then: the modification is rejected and the original entry remains unchanged with its original hash intact.

result.requirement: The system shall assign the authority to approve or reject a Dispute Ticket to a specific actor based on the ticket's origin, severity, and the involved partners.
result.business_need: The business needs a clear, automated assignment of dispute resolution authority to ensure fair, timely, and legally compliant handling of customer claims.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically assign the Platform Operator as the approver for disputes involving financial adjustments or regulatory violations.
The system shall automatically assign the Store Partner as the approver for disputes related to missing items or product quality originating from their inventory.
The system shall automatically assign the Delivery Partner as the approver for disputes related to delivery proof or late arrival caused by their performance.
The system shall prevent an actor from approving a Dispute Ticket where they are listed as the accused party in the incident.
The system shall escalate the Dispute Ticket to a Fulfillment Supervisor if the assigned actor does not respond within the defined timeframe.
The system shall record the assigned approver and their decision timestamp on the Dispute Ticket for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: The nature of the dispute issue (e.g., missing item, damage, late delivery)
The origin of the order (Store Partner or Delivery Partner)
The severity level of the dispute
The current resolution status of the ticket
The identity of the accused party in the dispute
business_rules: An actor cannot approve a Dispute Ticket where they are the accused party.
Disputes involving financial refunds must be approved by the Platform Operator.
Disputes regarding product quality must be approved by the Store Partner.
Disputes regarding delivery performance must be approved by the Delivery Partner.
Unresolved Dispute Tickets must be escalated to a Fulfillment Supervisor after the initial assignment deadline.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Dispute Ticket is created for a missing item originating from a Store Partner
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the ticket for authority assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: The Store Partner is assigned as the approver and the Platform Operator is excluded.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Dispute Ticket is created for a damaged package where the Delivery Partner is the accused party
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the ticket for authority assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: The Delivery Partner is excluded from approval and the Platform Operator is assigned as the approver.

result.requirement: The system shall prevent the submission of an Order Request if the calculated cart total is below the minimum order value defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
result.business_need: The business needs this to ensure economic viability by preventing the processing of orders that cannot cover operational costs or meet delivery thresholds.
functional_behaviour: The system shall calculate the total monetary value of all items in the Order Request before submission.
The system shall retrieve the minimum order value threshold associated with the specific Store Partner Agreement.
The system shall block the Order Request submission and display an error message if the cart total is less than the threshold.
The system shall allow the Order Request submission only if the cart total meets or exceeds the minimum order value.
The system shall update the Customer Profile to reflect the minimum order value constraint for future sessions.
The system shall log the validation attempt and the resulting decision in the Financial Transaction Record.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).
The active linkage between a ready order and a specific delivery agent, including the assigned route, estimated arrival time, and the agent's current workload status.
business_rules: An Order Request cannot be submitted if the sum of item prices is strictly less than the minimum order value defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
An Order Request can be submitted if the sum of item prices is equal to or greater than the minimum order value defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
The minimum order value must be dynamically retrieved from the Store Partner Agreement at the time of validation.
The system must display a clear error message to the Customer when the minimum order value is not met.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer adds items to their cart totaling $150 and the Store Partner Agreement requires a minimum of $100.
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer attempts to submit the Order Request.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system allows the submission and proceeds to the next step.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer adds items to their cart totaling $80 and the Store Partner Agreement requires a minimum of $100.
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer attempts to submit the Order Request.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system blocks the submission and displays an error message indicating the minimum order value is not met.

result.requirement: The system shall prevent the creation of an Order Request if the customer's delivery address falls outside the active boundaries of any defined Service Area Definition.
result.business_need: The business needs to enforce strict geofencing to ensure operational feasibility and prevent accepting orders that cannot be physically fulfilled within the hyperlocal zones.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve the precise geographic coordinates or polygon boundaries for all active Service Area Definitions associated with the Store Partner.
The system shall calculate the spatial relationship between the customer's delivery address and the defined Service Area boundaries.
The system shall block the Order Request submission and display a specific error message if the address is not contained within any valid zone.
The system shall allow the Order Request creation only if the delivery address is confirmed to be inside at least one active Service Area Definition.
The system shall validate the Service Area Definition status in real-time to ensure the zone is currently active for order acceptance.
related_information_requirements: The precise geographic coordinates, radii, or polygon boundaries defining the specific zones where the platform is authorized to operate.
Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers and delivery addresses.
business_rules: An order must not be created if the delivery address is geographically outside all active Service Area Definitions.
A Service Area Definition must be marked as active to allow order placement within its boundaries.
The system must validate the delivery address against the Service Area Definition at the moment of order submission.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to place an order with a delivery address inside an active Service Area Definition
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the Order Request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system allows the order creation and proceeds to the next step

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to place an order with a delivery address outside all defined Service Area Definitions
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the Order Request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system blocks the order creation and displays a message indicating the address is outside the service area

result.requirement: The system shall prevent the creation of an Order Request containing any Product Catalog item where the current date exceeds the item's expiry date or freshness threshold.
result.business_need: The business needs to prevent the sale of expired or unsafe perishable goods to protect customer health and maintain regulatory compliance.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for each item in the cart to verify current stock status.
The system shall compare the current date against the expiry date stored in the Product Catalog for every selected item.
The system shall block the Order Request submission and display an error message if any item is flagged as expired.
The system shall allow the Order Request submission only if all items pass the expiry date validation check.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect the removal of expired items from available stock.
The system shall log the validation attempt and the specific items rejected due to expiry status.
related_information_requirements: The current date and time at the moment of order submission.
The specific expiry date or freshness threshold for each sellable item.
The list of items selected by the customer with their quantities.
The current availability status of each item in the store.
business_rules: An item is considered expired if the current date is later than the item's defined expiry date.
An Order Request must contain zero expired items to be successfully created.
Items flagged as expired must be immediately excluded from the available inventory snapshot.
The system must validate expiry status for all items in the cart before finalizing the order.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer adds a product with a valid expiry date to the cart and proceeds to checkout.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system validates the order contents against the current date.
acceptance_criteria.then: The Order Request is successfully created and processed.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to add a product that has passed its expiry date to the cart.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system validates the order contents against the current date.
acceptance_criteria.then: The Order Request creation is blocked and an error message indicating the item is expired is displayed.

result.requirement: The system shall automatically calculate and apply the correct revenue share percentage to a Financial Transaction Record based on the active commission rate defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure accurate and compliant revenue distribution between the platform and store partners by dynamically applying contractual commission rates to every financial settlement.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve the active commission rate from the Store Partner Agreement associated with the specific Store Partner.
The system shall calculate the revenue share amount by applying the retrieved commission rate to the gross revenue of the Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall record the calculated commission amount and the net settlement amount in the Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall validate that the Store Partner Agreement is currently active before finalizing the commission calculation.
The system shall flag the Financial Transaction Record for manual review if the applicable Store Partner Agreement is missing or inactive.
related_information_requirements: The complete record of monetary exchange, detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and the net settlement amounts due to each party.
The legally binding contractual details between the platform and physical stores, including commission rates, payout schedules, liability clauses, and specific performance guarantees.
business_rules: The system shall use the commission rate from the most recently active Store Partner Agreement for any given transaction.
The system shall prevent the finalization of a Financial Transaction Record if no valid Store Partner Agreement exists for the involved Store Partner.
The system shall calculate the net settlement amount by subtracting the calculated commission from the gross revenue.
The system shall treat a Store Partner Agreement as inactive if its effective end date has passed or if it is explicitly marked as terminated.

acceptance_criteria.given: A valid Store Partner Agreement with a defined commission rate exists for the Store Partner involved in a transaction.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes a new Financial Transaction Record for that Store Partner.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system applies the agreement's commission rate to calculate the revenue share and generates the correct net settlement amount.

acceptance_criteria.given: No active Store Partner Agreement exists for the Store Partner involved in a transaction.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to process a new Financial Transaction Record for that Store Partner.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the Financial Transaction Record for manual review and does not finalize the commission calculation.

result.requirement: The system shall evaluate transaction patterns and consume third-party fraud detection services to assess risk scores for orders before processing.
result.business_need: The business needs this to prevent financial loss from fraudulent transactions and ensure secure payment processing.
functional_behaviour: The system shall ingest real-time transaction data and customer profile details to identify unusual order patterns.
The system shall consume external signals from a third-party fraud detection service to calculate a dynamic risk score.
The system shall automatically flag high-risk orders for manual review by the Payment Provider.
The system shall block or hold processing for orders exceeding the defined high-risk threshold until cleared.
The system shall log the risk assessment results and third-party response details for audit trails.
related_information_requirements: Indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions
Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers and delivery addresses
Complete record of monetary exchange detailing item costs and fees
Qualitative ratings and comments provided by the customer regarding service performance
business_rules: An order must be flagged for manual review if the calculated risk score exceeds the high-risk threshold.
The system must consume the third-party fraud detection service response before allowing any financial transaction to proceed.
High-risk orders must remain in a pending state until a Payment Provider explicitly approves or rejects them.
All risk assessment events must be recorded with a timestamp and the specific indicators that triggered the score.

acceptance_criteria.given: An order request is submitted with valid customer profile and payment details
acceptance_criteria.when: The system evaluates the transaction against third-party fraud indicators
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates a risk score and processes the order if the score is below the high-risk threshold

acceptance_criteria.given: An order request exhibits unusual patterns such as rapid address changes or mismatched billing data
acceptance_criteria.when: The system evaluates the transaction and receives a high-risk score from the third-party service
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the order for manual review and prevents the Financial Transaction Record from being finalized

result.requirement: The system shall securely connect with the Payment Provider to process customer payments, initiate fund transfers, and manage refunds or reversals for financial transactions.
result.business_need: The business requires a secure financial integration to accurately monetize transactions, settle funds between parties, and protect against financial loss through fraud detection and reversal capabilities.
functional_behaviour: The system shall validate the solvency of the payer and verify the security of the payment request before authorizing any fund transfer.
The system shall generate a complete Financial Transaction Record capturing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, commissions, and net settlement amounts.
The system shall initiate a refund or reversal process upon receiving a valid request from the Payment Provider or Store Partner.
The system shall cross-reference customer profile data and order details to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions.
The system shall expose real-time status indicators of the financial transaction to the Platform Operator and Store Partner.
The system shall link the financial transaction record with the Delivery Proof to confirm successful handover before final settlement.
related_information_requirements: Complete record of monetary exchange including costs, fees, taxes, and net settlement amounts.
Indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions.
Verified details about the ordering individual including unique identifiers and contact methods.
Evidence that physical goods have reached the customer to trigger final financial settlement.
business_rules: A financial transaction cannot be finalized until the Payment Provider validates the payer's solvency.
Refunds or reversals must be initiated only after a valid request is received from an authorized actor.
The system must capture all monetary components (costs, fees, taxes, commissions) in the transaction record.
Final settlement amounts are contingent upon the verification of the Delivery Proof.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer places an order with valid payment details
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the payment request via the Payment Provider
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with accurate net settlement amounts and confirms fund transfer.

acceptance_criteria.given: A dispute arises regarding a delivered order
acceptance_criteria.when: The Store Partner requests a refund through the Payment Provider interface
acceptance_criteria.then: The system initiates the reversal process and updates the Financial Transaction Record to reflect the refund status.

result.requirement: The system shall ingest real-time operational data from external logistics providers to monitor fleet availability and route constraints.
result.business_need: The business needs this to dynamically adjust delivery capacity and fees based on live network status, preventing service degradation during congestion.
functional_behaviour: The system shall establish secure, bi-directional data links with registered Payment Providers and Delivery Partners.
The system shall ingest live telemetry regarding agent location, speed, and current workload status.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect temporary unavailability caused by network disruptions.
The system shall recalculate estimated travel duration and distance based on current traffic patterns and route constraints.
The system shall flag Delivery Assignment records when external network status prevents meeting the assigned Delivery Slot.
The system shall expose network congestion metrics to the Fulfillment Supervisor for workload balancing.
related_information_requirements: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance accounting for traffic patterns
Status of the data link between the store and the platform including latency
Aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone
business_rules: The system shall treat a data link latency exceeding the defined threshold as a network disruption.
The system shall invalidate an Assigned Delivery Slot if the external network status indicates a route constraint.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to mark items as unavailable if the logistics link is down.
The system shall prioritize agents with lower workload status when assigning tasks during network congestion.

acceptance_criteria.given: The external logistics provider reports a route constraint due to traffic
acceptance_criteria.when: The system ingests this real-time data
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the travel duration estimate and flags the affected Delivery Assignment

acceptance_criteria.given: The data link between the store and the platform experiences high latency
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects this status exceeds the defined threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: The system marks the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot as unreliable and alerts the Fulfillment Supervisor

result.requirement: The system shall integrate with external mapping services to consume live traffic and road network data for calculating accurate delivery times.
result.business_need: Accurate delivery time estimates are critical for setting realistic fees, managing customer expectations, and optimizing fleet capacity.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve real-time traffic conditions and road network constraints from the external mapping service.
The system shall calculate dynamic travel duration and distance between the Store Partner and the customer address.
The system shall update the estimated arrival time for the Delivery Assignment based on current traffic patterns.
The system shall validate that the calculated route remains within the active Service Area Definition.
The system shall refresh delivery time estimates whenever significant traffic changes occur during the active delivery window.
related_information_requirements: Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance accounting for traffic patterns
Precise geographic coordinates defining the service zone boundaries
Verified delivery addresses and contact details for the ordering individual
business_rules: The system shall use live traffic data to adjust estimated arrival times whenever congestion exceeds a predefined threshold.
The system shall reject any calculated route that falls outside the authorized Service Area Definition.
The system shall recalculate delivery times immediately upon receiving an update from the external mapping service.
The system shall display the estimated arrival time to the Delivery Partner and Customer within five minutes of the last data refresh.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is created with a Store Partner and a valid customer address
acceptance_criteria.when: The system queries the external mapping service for current traffic conditions
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates and displays an estimated arrival time that reflects current road congestion

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is active and traffic conditions change significantly on the route
acceptance_criteria.when: The external mapping service pushes an update regarding road closures or heavy traffic
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the estimated arrival time and notifies the Delivery Partner of the delay

result.requirement: The system shall integrate with external tax services to dynamically calculate and remit applicable sales taxes for transactions within authorized service zones.
result.business_need: The business needs this to ensure full regulatory compliance and accurate financial reporting across varying jurisdictions.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve the current tax rate for the specific delivery zone associated with the Order Request.
The system shall apply the retrieved tax rate to the item costs and delivery fees to generate a Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall validate the tax calculation against the latest Regulatory Authority requirements before finalizing the order.
The system shall generate a Dispute Ticket if the calculated tax exceeds the maximum allowable threshold defined by the Regulatory Authority.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect tax-inclusive pricing for the Customer Profile.
related_information_requirements: Current records of licenses, permits, and regulatory adherence regarding data privacy for the specific operating zone.
The complete record of monetary exchange, detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and the net settlement amounts due to each party.
The precise geographic coordinates, radii, or polygon boundaries defining the specific zones where the platform is authorized to operate.
business_rules: The system shall not finalize an Order Request if the calculated tax rate exceeds the maximum threshold defined by the Regulatory Authority.
The system shall automatically generate a Dispute Ticket whenever a tax calculation error is detected during the Financial Transaction Record generation.
The system shall only apply tax rates from jurisdictions where the Service Area Definition confirms operational authorization.
The system shall update the Financial Transaction Record immediately upon receiving a new tax rate update from the external service.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is created for a customer in an authorized zone with a valid tax rate available.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the order and calculates the total cost.
acceptance_criteria.then: The Financial Transaction Record includes the correct tax amount based on the current Service Area Definition.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is created for a customer in a zone where the external tax service returns an error or missing rate.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to calculate the total cost for the Order Request.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a Dispute Ticket and prevents the order from being finalized until the tax issue is resolved.

result.requirement: The system shall automatically initiate a refund process when a dispute ticket is validated by the Regulatory Authority or when a delivery failure is confirmed by the Delivery Partner.
result.business_need: The business needs to automate financial reversals to ensure customer trust and operational efficiency when service failures or validated disputes occur.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically generate a refund transaction record upon receiving a validated dispute ticket or a confirmed delivery failure notification.
The system shall retrieve the original financial transaction record associated with the Order Request to calculate the exact refund amount.
The system shall update the Dispute Ticket status to 'Refund Initiated' and notify the Customer via their primary contact method.
The system shall prevent the Delivery Assignment from being re-allocated to a new Delivery Partner while the refund process is active.
The system shall log the refund initiation event with a timestamp and the specific reason code derived from the dispute or failure record.
related_information_requirements: Validated dispute details including nature of issue and resolution status
Original order line items, quantities, and unit prices
Original payment amount and transaction reference
Confirmation of delivery failure or successful handover status
Customer contact details for notification
business_rules: A refund must be initiated only after a dispute ticket is marked as validated or a delivery failure is explicitly confirmed.
The refund amount must match the total value of the items in the original Order Request.
No new Delivery Assignment can be created for the same Order Request while a refund is in progress.
The system must capture the specific reason code for the refund initiation to support financial auditing.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Dispute Ticket is created and subsequently validated by the Regulatory Authority
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the validation status update
acceptance_criteria.then: The system automatically initiates a refund and updates the ticket status to 'Refund Initiated'

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner reports a failed delivery attempt
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives the confirmed failure notification
acceptance_criteria.then: The system automatically initiates a refund and prevents any new Delivery Assignment for that Order Request

result.requirement: The system shall calculate and apply partial refunds for specific missing or damaged items within a valid Order Request based on verified inventory or delivery proof discrepancies.
result.business_need: The business needs to automatically adjust financial obligations for customers when specific items in an order are unavailable or damaged, ensuring accurate billing and maintaining trust without requiring manual intervention for every discrepancy.
functional_behaviour: The system shall identify the specific items in an Order Request that are flagged as missing or damaged based on Delivery Proof or Real-Time Inventory Snapshot data.
The system shall calculate the refund amount by multiplying the quantity of the affected items by their unit price as defined in the Product Catalog.
The system shall generate a Financial Transaction Record reflecting the deduction from the original payment and the issuance of the partial refund.
The system shall update the Customer Profile to reflect the refund status and notify the Customer via their primary contact method.
The system shall adjust the Financial Transaction Record associated with the Order Request to show the net payable amount after the partial refund is applied.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, and unit prices.
Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers and contact methods.
The current, validated quantity of each sellable item at a specific store location.
Information confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order.
business_rules: A partial refund shall only be triggered if the discrepancy is confirmed by a Delivery Proof or a Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicating unavailability.
The refund amount shall strictly equal the sum of the unit prices for the specific missing or damaged items, excluding any taxes or delivery fees.
A partial refund shall not be processed if the Order Request has already been fully refunded or cancelled.
The system shall prevent a partial refund calculation if the item in question is marked as permanently discontinued in the Product Catalog.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request contains three items where one is confirmed missing via Delivery Proof.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the discrepancy for a partial refund.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates the refund based only on the missing item's unit price and updates the Financial Transaction Record accordingly.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request contains items where the inventory shows partial stock but the Delivery Proof confirms full delivery.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to calculate a partial refund for missing items.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not generate a refund because the discrepancy is not confirmed as missing or damaged.

result.requirement: The system shall automatically reassign failed delivery tasks to available Delivery Partners based on proximity to the delivery address and current agent capacity.
result.business_need: The business needs to minimize customer wait times and operational costs by ensuring failed deliveries are quickly re-allocated to the most suitable available agent.
