functional_behaviour: The system shall identify all active Delivery Tasks marked with a failed status.
The system shall calculate the proximity and estimated travel time between the failed delivery address and all available Delivery Partners.
The system shall filter available Delivery Partners based on their current workload capacity and service area constraints.
The system shall select the optimal Delivery Partner for reassignment based on the lowest estimated travel time and highest capacity.
The system shall update the Delivery Assignment record to reflect the new agent and generate a notification for the selected Delivery Partner.
related_information_requirements: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance between the store location and potential customer addresses, accounting for traffic patterns and route constraints.
The active linkage between a ready order and a specific delivery agent, including the assigned route, estimated arrival time, and the agent's current workload status.
business_rules: A failed delivery task must be reassigned only if at least one Delivery Partner is available within the defined service area.
The system must prioritize the Delivery Partner with the shortest estimated travel time to the delivery address.
Reassignment is prohibited if the selected Delivery Partner has exceeded their maximum capacity threshold for the current shift.
The original Delivery Partner must be notified of the task cancellation before the new assignment is finalized.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Task has failed and no new delivery slot is immediately requested by the customer.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine scans for failed tasks and available agents.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system reassigns the task to the nearest available Delivery Partner who has remaining capacity.

acceptance_criteria.given: All Delivery Partners within the service area are at maximum capacity or outside the delivery radius.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to reassign a failed Delivery Task.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system marks the task as 'Pending Reassignment' and notifies the Fulfillment Supervisor instead of auto-assigning.

result.requirement: The system shall reverse inventory locks and financial reservations for an Order Request when a cancellation is confirmed before the Fulfillment Task reaches the 'Ready for Dispatch' status.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure that cancelled orders do not permanently reduce available stock or hold customer funds, maintaining accurate inventory levels and financial integrity.
functional_behaviour: The system shall identify all inventory units locked by the Order Request and release them back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
The system shall reverse any financial reservations associated with the Order Request and update the Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall update the Order Request status to 'Cancelled' and log the reversal details in the system audit trail.
The system shall prevent the release of inventory or funds if the Order Request has already transitioned to a 'Ready for Dispatch' state.
The system shall notify the Store Partner of the inventory release to confirm the rollback was successful.
related_information_requirements: The current, validated quantity of each sellable item at a specific store location.
The active linkage between a ready order and a specific delivery agent.
The specific list of items selected by the customer and their quantities.
business_rules: Inventory locks must be released immediately upon confirmation of cancellation before the Fulfillment Task status changes to 'Ready for Dispatch'.
Financial reservations must be reversed only if the Order Request has not yet been handed over to a Delivery Partner.
A cancellation rollback cannot be initiated if the order has already been physically picked and verified by the Store Partner.
The system must validate that the Order Request ID matches the inventory lock ID before releasing stock.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is in 'Processing' status with locked inventory and a financial reservation.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Customer initiates a cancellation and the system confirms it before dispatch.
acceptance_criteria.then: The inventory is released back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot and the financial reservation is reversed.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request has already transitioned to 'Ready for Dispatch' status.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Customer attempts to cancel the order.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the cancellation request and does not release any inventory or funds.

result.requirement: The system shall enable authorized agents and customers to upload photos and documents to substantiate dispute claims regarding delivery exceptions.
result.business_need: The business needs a centralized mechanism to collect verifiable evidence to resolve disputes fairly and accurately.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Customer and Delivery Partner to attach media files to an existing Dispute Ticket.
The system shall validate that uploaded files meet minimum quality standards before storing them.
The system shall associate the uploaded evidence directly with the specific Dispute Ticket and linked Order Request.
The system shall restrict upload permissions to only the actors involved in the specific dispute case.
The system shall generate a timestamped record of every file upload for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: The complete record of monetary exchange
Verifiable evidence that the physical goods have reached the customer
A structured record of any deviation from the standard process
business_rules: Only actors explicitly assigned to a Dispute Ticket may upload evidence for that specific ticket.
Uploaded evidence must be linked to the Order Request associated with the Dispute Ticket.
The system must prevent duplicate uploads of the same file for the same Dispute Ticket.
All uploaded evidence must be retained indefinitely for potential Regulatory Authority review.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer has an open Dispute Ticket for a damaged item
acceptance_criteria.when: The Customer uploads a photo of the damage via the portal
acceptance_criteria.then: The system associates the photo with the Dispute Ticket and marks the evidence as 'Submitted'

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner attempts to upload a Delivery Proof photo for a closed ticket
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects the ticket status is 'Resolved' and the actor is not the original claimant
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the upload and displays an error message stating the ticket is no longer active for evidence submission

result.requirement: The system shall route unresolved disputes to senior support tiers based on calculated severity and financial impact thresholds.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure high-risk disputes receive immediate expert attention to minimize financial loss and maintain platform trust.
functional_behaviour: The system shall calculate dispute severity by analyzing financial impact and fraud indicators.
The system shall automatically assign the dispute to a senior tier if severity exceeds defined thresholds.
The system shall notify the appropriate senior support agent upon successful escalation.
The system shall update the dispute ticket status to reflect the new handling tier.
The system shall log the escalation reason and timestamp for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: Monetary exchange details including costs and commissions
Fraud indicators and historical data
Current resolution status of the deviation
business_rules: A dispute must be escalated if the financial impact exceeds the standard liability limit.
A dispute must be escalated if fraud indicators suggest a high probability of fraudulent transaction.
Escalation must occur only after the initial support tier fails to resolve the issue within the standard timeframe.
The escalation path must strictly follow the hierarchy defined in the Store Partner Agreement.

acceptance_criteria.given: A dispute ticket exists with high financial impact and confirmed fraud indicators
acceptance_criteria.when: The initial support tier fails to resolve the issue
acceptance_criteria.then: The system automatically routes the ticket to a senior support tier

acceptance_criteria.given: A dispute ticket has low financial impact and no fraud indicators
acceptance_criteria.when: The initial support tier fails to resolve the issue
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not escalate the ticket to a senior support tier

result.requirement: The system shall send real-time notifications to customers regarding the status updates of their refund requests.
result.business_need: The business needs to maintain customer trust and reduce support volume by providing immediate transparency on refund processing stages.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically generate a notification when a refund request transitions from pending to approved or rejected.
The system shall include the updated refund status and the expected timeline for funds to appear in the customer's account within the notification.
The system shall deliver the notification via the communication channel previously selected by the customer in their profile.
The system shall log the timestamp and content of every status notification sent to the customer for audit purposes.
The system shall suppress duplicate notifications if the refund status has not changed since the last message.
related_information_requirements: Current status of the refund request
Expected timeline for fund availability
Preferred communication channel of the customer
business_rules: A notification must be sent immediately upon any change in the refund request status.
Notifications must only be sent if the new status differs from the status of the most recent notification.
The notification content must accurately reflect the current state of the Financial Transaction Record.
The system must verify the active communication channel exists before attempting to send a notification.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has submitted a refund request that is currently pending
acceptance_criteria.when: The system updates the request status to approved
acceptance_criteria.then: The system sends a notification to the customer confirming the approval and the expected fund arrival date

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has received a notification about a pending refund request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system updates the request status to rejected without changing the status again
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not send another notification to the customer

result.requirement: The system shall generate high-risk transaction alerts and perform refund/chargeback impact analysis to prevent financial loss before settlement.
result.business_need: The business needs to proactively identify fraudulent patterns and quantify potential financial exposure to stop unauthorized chargebacks before funds are settled.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze transaction indicators such as unusual order patterns, high-risk addresses, and payment anomalies to calculate fraud likelihood.
The system shall project the financial impact of potential refunds and chargebacks on net settlement amounts for the involved parties.
The system shall flag transactions exceeding the calculated risk threshold for immediate review by the Payment Provider.
The system shall update the Financial Transaction Record with the risk assessment status and projected liability.
The system shall notify the Payment Provider and Store Partner of the flagged transaction and the estimated financial impact.
related_information_requirements: Indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions
The complete record of monetary exchange detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, and net settlement amounts
Verifiable evidence that the physical goods have reached the customer
Verified details about the ordering individual including unique identifiers and delivery addresses
business_rules: A transaction must be flagged if the calculated fraud likelihood score exceeds the configured risk threshold.
The projected financial impact must include the sum of item costs, delivery fees, taxes, and platform commissions.
A transaction must remain flagged until the Payment Provider confirms the outcome or the settlement period expires.
The impact analysis must be recalculated if new delivery proof or customer verification data becomes available.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new Order Request contains indicators of unusual order patterns and a high-risk address
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the transaction for settlement
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall generate a high-risk alert and update the Financial Transaction Record with the projected chargeback liability

acceptance_criteria.given: A transaction is flagged as high-risk but lacks sufficient delivery proof
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to finalize the settlement calculation
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall withhold the net settlement amount and notify the Payment Provider of the pending dispute review

result.requirement: The system shall continuously reconcile platform revenue shares against store partner settlements in real-time.
result.business_need: This ensures financial accuracy and trust between the platform and store partners by immediately identifying and resolving discrepancies in revenue distribution.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically ingest financial transaction records and store partner agreement terms to calculate expected revenue shares.
The system shall compare calculated revenue shares against actual settlement amounts generated by the payment provider.
The system shall generate a financial transaction record flagging any detected discrepancies for immediate review.
The system shall update the status of the reconciliation process to reflect resolved or pending items.
The system shall provide a real-time view of reconciliation health to the platform operator and store partner.
related_information_requirements: Real-time status of data link integrity between store POS and platform
Legally binding contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules
Complete record of monetary exchange including item costs, fees, and net settlement amounts
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance affecting delivery fees
Current validated quantity of sellable items at specific store locations
business_rules: A discrepancy is flagged if the calculated revenue share differs from the settlement amount by more than zero.
Reconciliation status must update to 'Resolved' only after the discrepancy is corrected and verified.
Revenue share calculations must strictly adhere to the commission rates defined in the active Store Partner Agreement.
Settlement amounts must include all applicable taxes, delivery fees, and platform commissions as per the Financial Transaction Record.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new order is completed and the Payment Provider confirms the transaction.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the financial data against the Store Partner Agreement.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates the revenue share and updates the Financial Transaction Record within seconds.

acceptance_criteria.given: The calculated revenue share does not match the settlement amount due to a data sync error.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects the discrepancy during the real-time reconciliation cycle.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the Financial Transaction Record as 'Discrepancy Detected' and notifies the Platform Operator.

result.requirement: The system shall automatically compute and collect applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and product type during the order processing workflow.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure legal compliance and accurate revenue collection by dynamically applying the correct tax rates to every transaction.
functional_behaviour: The system shall determine the applicable tax jurisdiction based on the delivery address and product origin.
The system shall retrieve the current tax rate for the specific product category within the determined jurisdiction.
The system shall calculate the tax amount by applying the rate to the taxable subtotal of the Order Request.
The system shall add the calculated tax to the Financial Transaction Record before finalizing the payment.
The system shall generate a breakdown of tax components visible to the Customer Profile.
The system shall validate that the total tax collected matches the liability required by the Regulatory Authority.
related_information_requirements: The complete record of monetary exchange, detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and the net settlement amounts due to each party.
The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.
A structured record of any deviation from the standard process, such as missing items, damaged goods, or failed deliveries, including the nature of the issue and current resolution status.
business_rules: Tax must be calculated only on the subtotal of taxable items, excluding delivery fees and platform commissions.
The system must use the most current tax rate available for the specific jurisdiction at the time of order placement.
If a product is non-taxable in the delivery zone, the tax amount recorded must be zero.
The tax calculation must be reproducible using the same Order Request, Product Catalog, and Delivery Zone Map data.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is created for a taxable item delivered to a specific zone
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: The Financial Transaction Record includes the exact tax amount calculated from the current rate for that zone and product category

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is created for a non-taxable item or a zone with zero tax rate
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: The Financial Transaction Record shows a tax amount of zero and no tax line item is generated

result.requirement: The system shall calculate and settle multi-currency transactions by converting amounts using real-time exchange rates and recording all financial details in the base currency of the Platform Operator.
result.business_need: The business needs this to ensure accurate revenue collection and fair settlement for Store Partners and Delivery Partners regardless of the transaction's original currency.
functional_behaviour: The system shall capture the transaction amount, currency, and applicable exchange rate for every Order Request.
The system shall convert all monetary values to the Platform Operator's base currency for settlement calculations.
The system shall record the gross amount, platform commission, and net settlement amount for each party involved.
The system shall generate a Financial Transaction Record that includes the original currency, converted amount, and exchange rate used.
The system shall validate that the Store Partner Agreement allows transactions in the selected currency before processing.
The system shall flag any transaction where the exchange rate fluctuation exceeds a predefined tolerance threshold for review.
related_information_requirements: The complete record of monetary exchange, detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and the net settlement amounts due to each party.
The legally binding contractual details between the platform and physical stores, including commission rates, payout schedules, liability clauses, and specific performance guarantees.
business_rules: The system shall only allow currency conversion if the Store Partner Agreement explicitly permits transactions in the selected currency.
The system shall record the exchange rate used at the exact moment the Financial Transaction Record is created.
The system shall calculate the net settlement amount by subtracting the platform commission from the converted gross amount.
The system shall reject the transaction if the exchange rate source is unavailable or invalid.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer places an Order Request with a Store Partner in a foreign currency
acceptance_criteria.when: The Payment Provider processes the payment and the system calculates the settlement
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record showing the original amount, the converted base currency amount, and the correct net settlement for the Store Partner

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner Agreement does not allow transactions in the currency selected by the customer
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to process the multi-currency transaction
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the Order Request and notifies the Payment Provider that the currency is not supported under the current agreement

result.requirement: The system shall generate an immutable audit trail for every Financial Transaction Record and Settlement event to ensure financial integrity and regulatory compliance.
result.business_need: The business requires a tamper-proof record of all monetary exchanges to resolve disputes, satisfy regulatory audits, and accurately calculate revenue shares.
functional_behaviour: The system shall append every financial transaction entry to a write-once, append-only log structure.
The system shall cryptographically hash each new entry against the previous entry to maintain chain integrity.
The system shall record the full details of the Financial Transaction Record including costs, fees, taxes, and net settlement amounts.
The system shall timestamp every entry with a synchronized, non-adjustable time source.
The system shall prevent any actor from modifying, deleting, or reordering existing audit log entries.
related_information_requirements: Complete record of monetary exchange detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
Cryptographic hash of the preceding log entry to verify chain integrity.
Immutable timestamp synchronized to a trusted time source.
Digital signature of the entity initiating the transaction.
business_rules: An audit log entry must be created immediately upon the finalization of a Financial Transaction Record status.
Any attempt to modify an existing audit log entry must be rejected and logged as a security violation.
The audit trail must include the full context of the Store Partner Agreement applicable to the transaction.
Audit logs must be accessible to the Regulatory Authority without requiring Platform Operator approval.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Payment Provider completes a settlement for a Financial Transaction Record
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the settlement event
acceptance_criteria.then: An immutable audit log entry is created with a unique hash linking it to the previous entry

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner attempts to edit a finalized audit log entry for a Financial Transaction Record
acceptance_criteria.when: The system validates the request against the immutable log structure
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the modification request and logs the attempt as a security violation

result.requirement: The system shall execute a scheduled batch process to calculate, validate, and distribute financial settlements to Store Partners and Delivery Partners based on finalized transaction data.
result.business_need: The business needs this to automate accurate fund distribution, ensuring partners receive correct payments while maintaining financial integrity and compliance with contractual agreements.
functional_behaviour: The system shall aggregate all Order Requests with confirmed Delivery Proof and valid Financial Transaction Records within the defined settlement window.
The system shall apply commission rates and fee structures defined in the Store Partner Agreement to calculate net settlement amounts for each party.
The system shall validate that the total settlement amount for a transaction does not exceed the available funds in the corresponding Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall generate a Financial Transaction Record for each successful settlement and update the Customer Profile to reflect the completed payment status.
The system shall flag any settlement batch items where the Delivery Proof is missing or the Store Partner Agreement is expired for manual review.
The system shall generate a summary report of the batch processing results available to the Platform Operator for audit and reconciliation purposes.
related_information_requirements: Complete record of monetary exchange including item costs, fees, taxes, and net amounts
Verifiable evidence of physical goods handover to the customer
Legally binding contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules
Unified digital representation of sellable items and pricing
Verified details about the ordering individual including unique identifiers and addresses
business_rules: A settlement batch must only include Order Requests where the Delivery Proof status is verified as successful.
The net settlement amount must be calculated strictly according to the active commission rates in the Store Partner Agreement.
Settlements cannot be processed if the associated Store Partner Agreement is expired or terminated.
Any discrepancy between the calculated settlement amount and the available Financial Transaction Record must trigger a batch halt for that specific item.
The system must exclude any Order Request flagged with high-risk indicators from the automated settlement batch.

acceptance_criteria.given: All Order Requests in the batch have valid Delivery Proof and active Store Partner Agreements
acceptance_criteria.when: The scheduled batch processing job runs at the defined time
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates Financial Transaction Records with correct net amounts and updates partner balances

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request in the batch has an expired Store Partner Agreement or missing Delivery Proof
acceptance_criteria.when: The scheduled batch processing job runs at the defined time
acceptance_criteria.then: The system excludes the item from the batch and logs it as a failed settlement for manual review

result.requirement: The system shall identify and flag suspicious financial patterns in financial transactions requiring manual review before settlement.
result.business_need: The business needs this to prevent financial loss from fraud, reduce chargeback liabilities, and ensure accurate revenue settlement.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze Financial Transaction Records against historical data and risk indicators to detect anomalies.
The system shall automatically flag transactions meeting suspicious pattern criteria for manual review by the Payment Provider.
The system shall prevent automatic settlement for flagged transactions until a Payment Provider resolves the review.
The system shall log the specific risk indicators and transaction details associated with each flagged event.
The system shall notify the Payment Provider of the flagged transaction and the reasons for the flag.
related_information_requirements: Indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions
The complete record of monetary exchange detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, and net settlement amounts
Verifiable evidence that the physical goods have reached the customer
Qualitative ratings and comments provided by the customer regarding the product quality and agent behavior
business_rules: A transaction is flagged if it exhibits unusual order patterns compared to the customer's historical behavior.
A transaction is flagged if it originates from a high-risk address or location not associated with the customer's profile.
A transaction is flagged if the payment method or amount deviates significantly from the customer's typical transaction profile.
Flagged transactions must remain in a pending state and cannot be settled until a Payment Provider manually approves or rejects them.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new financial transaction is initiated by a customer with a history of small purchases
acceptance_criteria.when: The transaction amount is significantly higher than the customer's average and the address is flagged as high-risk
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the Financial Transaction Record for manual review and prevents automatic settlement

acceptance_criteria.given: A financial transaction is processed for a new customer with no historical data
acceptance_criteria.when: The transaction amount exceeds the platform's standard threshold for new accounts without additional verification
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the Financial Transaction Record for manual review and prevents automatic settlement
